title: Titration Procedure
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package that contains the custom beaker labware definition.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the custom beaker labware definition file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the titration protocol file into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the custom beaker + stir plate in slot 4, the waste beaker in slot 8, the 4‑in‑1 tube rack with 50 mL conical tubes (containing reagents) in slot 9, and the 1000 µL tip rack in slot 11, exactly as shown on the deck map.

substeps.instruction: Slot 9: Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack with 50 mL conical tubes

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the deck, all labware, and the P1000 single‑channel pipette (mounted on the right) according to the app’s calibration workflow.

steps.title: Perform liquid transfers
steps.instruction: For each tube in the rack (slot 9), the P1000 pipette picks up a fresh 1000 µL tip from the tip rack (slot 11), aspirates 2 mL from the bottom of the tube (do not overfill the tube), dispenses 2 mL into the beaker in slot 4, pauses for the predetermined amount of time, then dispenses 2 mL from that beaker into the waste beaker in slot 8, and finally discards the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new 1000 µL tip from slot 11
Aspirate 2 mL from the bottom of the current tube in slot 9
Dispense 2 mL into the beaker in slot 4
Wait the predetermined amount of time
Dispense 2 mL from slot 4 into the waste beaker in slot 8

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol on the OT‑2 robot.
